item.title: Emiliano Ariel Videla Rodriguez
item.dc:creator: Teaching co-ordinator
item.description:
Hi there! My name is Emiliano and I am part of the DDI Health and Social Care Talent team. My role in the team is as a teaching co-ordinator, supporting course organisers with the delivery of courses, demonstrating tutorials, and contributing with different activities, including the development of this website.

Education

I did the equivalent of an integrated master program in biological sciences at the Universidad Nacional de Córdoba, Argentina. I then moved on to a first PhD, at the same university, in biological sciences where, although my main research topic was poultry science and poultry industry, I started my journey in statistical programming.

I started a second PhD working at the University of St. Andrews, in Scotland, and enrolled in a PhD programme at the Universitat de Lleida, Spain, where I specialised myself in the applications of Bayesian networks to understand relationships between the elements of complex systems.

Latest articles

2025
